text:
aaron: Quick sync — I'm putting up a proposal for an 'onboard incentive lane' where early customers get migration credits if they run our standard bench and hit quality + performance gates. thoughts?
marta: Love the idea. What's the exact incentive? credits? free Dedicated hours? :moneybag:
aaron: Thinking 5k usage credits + 2 weeks of Dedicated test capacity, conditional on passing benchmark script v3 and no >5% regression on our eval prompt set.
kevin: How are we measuring pass/fail? need concrete thresholds (latency p95, cost per 1k tokens, eval accuracy). also who signs off?
aaron: Draft thresholds I'm proposing: latency p95 < 200ms for requests with seq <= 1024; throughput >= 50 tokens/sec per GPU under typical batching; embed cosine > 0.88 on our 100-sample probe. Signoff = product + eng-ml.
sara: Concern — customers might overfit to the probe. Can we run the probe with an unlabeled holdout and track production divergence? Also need a canary + rollback plan if we see regression post-cutover.
kevin: Agree on holdout. Also suggest limiting the incentive to new onboardings only and require a one-time migration window. Ops question: can Dedicated burst capacity be scheduled for these runs? @bench-bot can you confirm.
bench-bot: Reminder: Dedicated pool capacity requests must be submitted >=7 days before the window. Use /capacity-request and include model + peak qps + duration. :robot_face:
marta: We'll need a comms playbook and legal signoff — may affect SLA language. Also: how does this interact with pin exemptions?
aaron: Propose a 30-day pin exemption for customers who hit the gates, then auto-evaluate at 30d for stability (metrics collection + regression check). If we detect regressions, we can roll-forward compatible variants or reclaim credits.
kevin: Sounds actionable. I'll draft a short spec with concrete metrics, the playbook steps (request, bench run, signoff, cutover, 30d eval), and the cost guardrails. Can we review tomorrow 9am PT?
marta: :thumbsup: Added to calendar. Small ask — include a hard cost upper bound per customer in the spec so finance can pre-approve.
